editorial.blurb: The Avondale Coffee Club is a cozy, vibrantly designed coffee shop where exceptional pour-overs and creative lattes meet a warm, retro atmosphere that feels like stepping into a beloved sitcom.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive before 9:30 AM on weekends to snag a quiet table and easy parking on Elston—the crowd swells quickly by mid-morning.

topDishes.note: Vibrant flavors that justify the price point
One of the best reviewers have tried
